API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Credential ManagementUpdates the privileged credential details for the specified ID.
Updates the privileged credential details for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/credential/:id

Updates the privileged credential details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the privileged credential.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
creationTime
int32
credentialType
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [USERNAME_PASSWORD, SSH_KEY, PASSWORD]

description
string
id
int64
lastCredentialResetTime
int32
microtenantId
int64
microtenantName
string
modifiedBy
int64
modifiedTime
int32
name
string
REQUIRED
passphrase
string
password
string
privateKey
string
userDomain
string
userName
string
